ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, it is known that $ OB$ is a ray inside $ \angle AOC$, $ OE$ bisects $ \angle AOC$, and $ OF$ bisects $ \angle BOC$. If $ AO\perp BO$ and $ \angle BOC=60^\circ$, find the measure of $ \angle EOF$.
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given $AO\perp BO$, $\angle BOC=60^\circ$\\
$\therefore \angle AOB=90^\circ, \angle AOC=\angle AOB+\angle BOC=150^\circ$\\
Since OE bisects $\angle AOC$, and OF bisects $\angle BOC$\\
$\therefore \angle EOC=\frac{1}{2}\angle AOC=75^\circ, \angle COF=\frac{1}{2}\angle BOC=30^\circ$\\
$\therefore \angle EOF=\angle EOC-\angle COF=75^\circ-30^\circ=\boxed{45^\circ}$
